free_tier.stated: 'Hashnix is a non-commercial, free to join pubnix. All services are provided free-of-charge as public service. Services include: Free shell account (SSH), Media portal, Group chat (dream), Site-hosting (Gopher, Gemini, HTTP), Bulletin Board (bbj), E-mail + more available programs by signing up for membership and logging into the system.'
free_tier.notes: no disk quota, RAM figure, traffic allowance or process limit is published on any page read; the terms, the about page, the print index and the register page were all read and none states one

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a home directory, not an object

retention.stated: not stated: no inactivity clock, deletion policy or archival rule appears on the terms, about, print index or register pages
retention.notes: a documented absence, and it may not be used in arithmetic

egress.terms: not stated: no traffic volume, shaping tier or bandwidth figure appears on any page read

record.interface_detail: SSH shell account, plus site hosting over Gopher, Gemini and HTTP, a bulletin board (bbj), local group chat (dream), e-mail, a media/radio portal and an Icecast stream
record.tooling: any SSH client; the vendor's own CGI tools for radio and media; gopher and gemini clients
record.chaining: a small open-registration pubnix with SSH, cron-capable shell and HTTP hosting, which is a place to run a script and publish a page but has no published quota to plan against

limits.value: registration is a form reviewed by a human; the form asks for username, email, 'about me', 'sign-up purpose' and an optional SSH public key
no quota is published anywhere read; the limit is not knowable from the site

record.binding_note: the account exists only after a human reads a free-text application, and no quota is published, so there is nothing to design a workload against even once accepted

identity_cost.detail: No card, no hold, no phone, no document. The registration form as served has exactly three inputs. A text field named 'name', a text field named 'contact', and a submit button — plus three textareas named 'message', 'purpose' and 'cert' rendered as 'about me', 'sign-up purpose' and 'SSH-pubkey (optional)'. The terms add an age gate: 'All registrants of user accounts must be 18+ years of age.'.

record.reliability_note: the vendor published a key-rotation and CVE notice on 2026-05-15 and an amendment on 2026-05-20, including 'the SSH keys have been rotated and you are safe to replace previously used keystores'; no outage was observed.
record.confidence_note: the service list, the terms and the registration form are quoted from first-party pages read. The quota is a documented absence, not a documented limit, and the record's verdict does not rest on it

evidence.proved: quoted: 'Hashnix is a non-commercial, free to join pubnix. All services are provided free-of-charge as public service.' and the service list 'Free shell account (SSH), Media portal, Group chat (dream), Site-hosting (Gopher, Gemini, HTTP), Bulletin Board (bbj), E-mail'
the served markup: form action='register.php' with inputs named 'name' and 'contact', a submit input, and textareas named 'message', 'purpose' and 'cert'; no card, phone or document field

quoted: 'All registrants of user accounts must be 18+ years of age.' and 'The services provided by Hashnix are provided as is. We do not warrant the reliability, accessibility or quality of our services'
quoted: 'powered by Debian 13 64-bit | hosting made possible by contabo' - the platform and the upstream host
the portal page as served: '🚧🚧 ~ Under Construction ~ 🚧🚧', so no self-service control panel exists yet
quoted: 'powered by Debian 13 64-bit | hosting made possible by contabo' — the platform and the upstream host

record.notes: The caveat is the absence of any published quota: a shell account with no stated disk, memory or traffic limit is a discretionary allocation, which is worse to plan against than a small published one. The 18+ gate is a statement of terms and was not tested. What could not be established: the actual disk and memory limits, the traffic allowance, whether cron and a listening port are permitted, and whether the human review accepts a stranger.

extras.price_arithmetic: no price: the site states all services are free of charge and the form collects no payment
